synthesis.body: Starlight (0.41) wraps every markdown heading in <div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-hN"> and sets the heading itself to display:inline (for anchor-link hover). Any block-level decoration — border-bottom rules, full-width padding — applied to the h2 selector renders at text width, not column width. Put block decoration on the wrapper (.sl-heading-wrapper.level-h2) and keep type styles on the heading. Caught by visual QA in the docs-site-design-refresh; the short hairline under h2s was invisible to build gates.
